definitions.explanation: An art exhibition featuring the work of a single artist. Short for {個人|こじん}{展覧会|てんらんかい}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧、⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{個展|こてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: Next month, I'm holding my first solo exhibition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{個展|こてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{画廊|がろう}→画廊：16430_garou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to a gallery to see a friend's solo exhibition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国内外|こくないがい}→国内外：17208_kokunaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{個展|こてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いている→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真家|しゃしんか}→写真家：05501_shashinka⟧だ。
examples.english: She is a popular photographer who holds solo exhibitions both domestically and abroad.

notes:
USAGE:
{個展|こてん} is the standard word for a solo art exhibition. It is an abbreviation of ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧ (individual exhibition).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個展|こてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (to hold a solo exhibition)
- {個展|こてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}する→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧ (to organize a solo exhibition)
- ⟦{初|はつ}→初：10632_hatsu⟧{個展|こてん} (first solo exhibition)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧ is the general term for "exhibition." ⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧⟦{展|てん}→〜展：28468_ten⟧ is a group exhibition. {回顧展|かいこてん} is a retrospective exhibition.
